original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚报告非洲最新疫情首例埃博拉病例
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚政府确认，该国出现非洲最新一轮埃博拉疫情的首例病例，患者为一名从乌干达乘国际航班抵达首都阿布贾的女性。该患者在一家私立医院接受数日治疗后确诊。自5月刚果（金）宣布大规模埃博拉疫情以来，这种致命的病毒性出血热已蔓延至包括邻国乌干达在内的多个非洲国家。

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigeria records first Ebola case of Africa's latest outbreak

key_facts.fact: 患者为一名从乌干达乘国际航班抵达首都阿布贾的女性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a woman who had travelled from Uganda to the capital Abuja

key_facts.fact: 该患者在私立医院接受数日治疗后确诊
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: was admitted to a private hospital... where she received care for several days before the diagnosis was confirmed

key_facts.fact: 自5月刚果（金）宣布大规模埃博拉疫情以来，疫情已蔓延至包括乌干达在内的多个非洲国家
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Since a major Ebola outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May, the deadly viral haemorrhagic fever has spread to several countries across the continent, including to neighbouring Uganda
